description: Compute when a period expires under the Korean Civil Act (arts. 155-161), the default rule when a law or contract does not say otherwise: the first day is not counted unless the period starts at 00:00; weeks, months and years follow the calendar and end the day before the corresponding date (or at month end if that date does not exist); if the last day is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday the deadline moves to the next working day. Use for "within 14 days of receipt", "1 month from notice", contract terms. Not legal advice; some statutes set their own rules. Holiday data covers 2024-2027 (source: KASI; updated 2026-11-12). It includes substitute holidays and election days, and the 2026 additions Labor Day (May 1) and Constitution Day (Jul 17).

event_date.description: Date of the triggering event (notice received, contract signed), YYYY-MM-DD

extra_closed_dates.description: Optional extra non-working dates (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. company holidays.

starts_at_midnight.description: True if the period starts at 00:00 of event_date (e.g. a date fixed in advance); then the first day counts. Default false.
